reviewedBehavior: The S21 Electron case loads actual Settings and viewer pages with the production preload; controlled private IPC handlers provide owner snapshots and save receipts. It invokes real SearchEngine cancel and retry methods for legacy action checks.

The evidence records an Electron ARIA assertion RED after successful setup, followed by semantic RED assertions for unsafe canonical cancel, suppressed legacy controls, false owner READY copy, and full-rebuild Cancel. This review inspected the corresponding tests and reran GREEN; historical RED output is documented in the S21 evidence file.

The mixed product-shaped payload with public rebuilding and owner READY announces rebuilding. Global ingress-capacity copy reports deferred indexing without claiming a save; viewer copy says Saved only after its own successful private save receipt and retains the file path.

Full legacy rebuild and owner-only states cannot invoke legacy Cancel or Retry. A supported active non-rebuild legacy worker retains Cancel through private IPC with focus preserved. A failed legacy Retry result remains visible after refresh.

The Settings live region has role=status, aria-live=polite, and aria-atomic=true. The Electron case verifies state and progress-bucket announcements, no heartbeat-only repeats, terminal 100 percent once, unrecoverable role=alert, and no automatic focus move.

The registry matches all 30 approved state-to-code pairs. Four locale JSON files have equal key sets and translated state labels. Public state precedence and the existing eight-tool MCP contract remain unchanged.
